notes.title: New Update - Build 1.05
notes.notes:
Hello!

Our new update 1.05 is here. Check below the list of improvements we did since launch:

- New save slot system implemented.
- A 6th shift (3 more calls) was added in the second half of the game.
- Player movement improved
- An option to skip battle was added after you fail the last battle two times.
- Minor bugs and adjustments.

notes.title: New Update!
notes.notes:
Hi! It's time for a new update!

This one gives you around 2x more gameplay than the previous version. More calls, battles, soundtracks, achievements, and another big chunk of the story.

I also added requested features like shake function for combat, ultra-widescreen auto scale, more hints for missions, solved bugs, and more. The game is a lot more polished now.

I uploaded a new trailer too!

If you have any suggestions or find any bugs/errors, please leave a message at the forum or send me a direct message! 

PS: As the whole combat went through some sort of overhaul, your old save will not be compatible with this new version.

To stay up to date with our latest news, visit karmacitypolice.com or http://www.twitter.com/mecagamesdev

notes.title: Another update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

A new update is available!
- 16 achievements fully implemented.
- More calls, fights, story, soundtracks and much more.
- Now we have around 1 hour of gameplay.

If you have any suggestions, or find any bugs, please leave a message at the forum or send me a direct message!

notes.title: First major update.
notes.notes:
Hello!

First of all I would like to thank you all for the messages and feedback. They were very important to improve many aspects of the game. I would like to announce now our first major update.

[list]
[*]This new version gives you about 30 minutes of play time. More rooms, characters, calls, soundtracks...
[*]A more polished experience.
[*]Joystick Support.
[/list]

If you have any suggestions, or find any bugs, please leave a message at the forum or send me a direct message!
